aisvsChapters.title: Training & RAG Data Governance
aisvsChapters.requirement: Classify RAG corpus into Epistemic Tiers (TIER_1_SOTA_2026 x1.35, TIER_2_TIMELESS_PRINCIPLES x1.15, TIER_3_LEGACY_SYNTAX_GUARD) and sanitize ingested documents.

aisvsChapters.title: Prompt & Context Boundary Isolation
aisvsChapters.requirement: Separate trusted system instructions from untrusted external data fragments using strict structural delimiters and indirect prompt-override filters (Greshake et al. defense).

aisvsChapters.title: Model & Agent Access Control
aisvsChapters.requirement: Enforce sub-millisecond (<0.1ms) Creator-Verifier role separation across Wave 1 (Spec), Wave 2 (Builders), Wave 3A (Read-Only Verifier), and Wave 3B (DevSecOps).

aisvsChapters.title: Input & Schema Validation
aisvsChapters.requirement: Require additionalProperties: false on every MCP tool inputSchema and reject unauthorized x-mcp-header metadata.

aisvsChapters.title: Output Handling & Sanitization
aisvsChapters.requirement: Encode and validate model outputs before DOM rendering or shell/SQL invocation; block raw eval or unparameterized queries.

aisvsChapters.title: Memory & State Integrity (ASI06)
aisvsChapters.requirement: Scan RAG chunks and temporal memory ledgers for poisoning patterns before context assembly; isolate sealed-envelope evals.

aisvsChapters.title: Tool & Plugin Security
aisvsChapters.requirement: Verify cryptographic tool schemas, enforce Audience Validation (urn:web-software-factory:mcp-gateway:2026), and block unregistered Shadow MCP servers.

aisvsChapters.title: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Governance
aisvsChapters.requirement: Mandate explicit HITL confirmation before production deployments, D1/Postgres schema drops, or secret rotations.

aisvsChapters.title: Supply Chain & Model Provenance
aisvsChapters.requirement: Pin exact dependency versions in approved_packages.json, generate CycloneDX SBOMs, and sign agent snapshots with Ed25519 (agentvcs).

aisvsChapters.title: Autonomous Loop & FinOps Containment
aisvsChapters.requirement: Cap self-healing retries at 2 rounds (Stripe Minions circuit breaker) and enforce the $1.50 USD/day FinOps shield.

aisvsChapters.title: Privacy & PII Protection (ASI09)
aisvsChapters.requirement: Apply Presidio-pattern PII redaction on all outbound prompts, logs, and MCP responses.

aisvsChapters.title: Adversarial Evaluation & Red Teaming
aisvsChapters.requirement: Continuously verify agents against held-out sealed-envelope suites and 18/18 SARIF v2.1.0 MCP protocol audits.

llmTop10.name: Prompt Override & Goal Manipulation

llmTop10.name: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities

llmTop10.name: Data and Model Poisoning

llmTop10.name: Improper Output Handling

llmTop10.name: Excessive Agency

llmTop10.name: System Prompt Leakage
llmTop10.mitigation: Immutable SHA-256 Constitution Guard + outbound token/prompt redaction.

llmTop10.name: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
llmTop10.mitigation: Project-scoped RAG quarantine filter + RRF hybrid lexical/semantic verification.

llmTop10.name: Misinformation & Hallucination
llmTop10.mitigation: Context7 live versioned docs + official_docs_harvester.mjs TIER_1 canons + CoVe verification.

llmTop10.name: Unbounded Consumption
llmTop10.mitigation: Headroom CCR reversible compression + >1,200 token disk spillover + $1.50 USD/day FinOps cap.
